snippet.title: Wraith of the Cards | "Take the Call" Trailer
snippet.description:
Wraith of the Cards is an RPG / 2D platform hybrid where you collect cards to use toward puzzles and in turn-based combat!

Take the call as Crystal Piquet, a sorceress who received a mysterious letter telling her to come to a magical mansion! Use your magic Card Abilities to travel through the vast halls of the mansion, and to defend yourself against monsters! Unlock over 20 unique Special Cards as you unravel your journey to find your sommoner in Wraith of the Cards!

Releasing March 25th 2026!

Wishlist the game on Steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3963010/Wraith_of_the_Cards/
